stories.title: Ideas & Opinions — Ron Sadler: Why I vote Democratic
stories.summary: The first time I ever voted, I chose all Republican candidates. Growing up, I was deeply influenced by my conservative (and loving) grandfather. However, the Republican Party in those years was very different from the party it is today.

stories.title: Temporary boat launch closures planned for Barbara Schmidt Millar Triathlon
